fidelity: F1b — Flue Gas Loss + Moisture Correction + Cycling Standby
source: EN 303-5:2012 Boilers for solid fuels; Obernberger & Thek (2008) The Pellet Handbook; Jenkins et al. (1998) Prog. Energy Comb. Sci. 24, 47-81; BRE Report BR 443 (2006).

a2.notes: Negative — efficiency peaks near PLR~0.9 then falls at low load

PLR_min.notes: EN 303-5 requires >= 0.3 for category 3/4; 0.15 with modulating burner

LHV_dry_MJ_kg.description: Lower heating value of dry biomass

excess_air_ratio.notes: 1.2-1.5 typical for biomass; higher than NG due to char burnout

stoich_afr.notes: ~5.7 for cellulosic biomass (vs 17.2 for H2, 9.5 for CH4)

T_flue_full.description: Flue gas temperature at full load
T_flue_full.notes: Higher than NG due to ash/char; condensing biomass ~55-60 degC

standby_loss_fraction.description: Standby heat loss as fraction of Q_rated
standby_loss_fraction.notes: Casing loss + ash handling + induced draft fan

cycling_loss_fraction.description: Additional start/stop cycling loss as fraction of Q_rated
cycling_loss_fraction.notes: EN 303-5 Annex A cycling test; increases at low PLR
